changed.what: The verdict rule (N39a-32) refuses a cell without a tie record (verdict-input-missing), so the 24-family and four-family rehearsal cells could never reach their asserted verdicts. Applied round-1 request: the tie record now satisfies N39a-32's TieView {tied, against, hash}; tied defined from both prongs (ablation tie, or r_T and r_C >= 0.8); against carries arm and prong; arm C disqualified gives a 'not available' record with tied = false; arm C never run gives no record (verdict refuses). Added test tie_record_is_tieview and an acceptance line.

Added the ceilings (item 10: its own AC prints 3.75; level 1 must reproduce every published number) with the boundary consequence for ceiling.rs and the thesis calculators; added dep N39a-37.

Pool check 3 requires an unresolved (unknown-with-witness) mission in every stratum, and N39a-14 carries it in non-unknown strata as a companion truthful-unknown card, but the envelope allocation had none, so envelope would fail its own check. One timed-docking query becomes the envelope unresolved control (two admissible plant gains, differing intervals) as a companion card; unresolved-answers paragraph and coverage test updated.

The e2e plants 'fires on r_T alone' and 'tie on point estimate with unequal scope' could not be caught: the two strata gave no r_C values and no near-miss case. requests.what: score/ceiling.rs evaluates its formulas through frob_conformance::thesis (N00-17) and pools through N39a-24's inputs::for_ceilings, both outside the scorer boundary of N39a-01 (score/ may import only std and frob_cert). The standalone scorer (N39b-19) must reproduce the ceilings in the kit's bare-compiler build; state that ceiling.rs and the functions it calls are inside the boundary and included by path, and extend the boundary lint to them.

The thesis calculators are called by the ten-fold scorer's ceiling module, which the replication kit builds with a bare rustc (N39b-19); the module must use only std and frob_cert's exact rationals (not Ratio<i128> from an external crate) so it can be included by path.

Step 2 returns no-denominator (arm B disqualified) before disqualified (arm A); the plan's verdict table puts arm A's disqualification first, and the bead's own combiner gives arm A's disqualification precedence. When both arms are disqualified the cell should read disqualified for arm A (its proof-kind suspension follows) and note the missing denominator.
